shared.awaitingTitle: Current stage: {{stage}} — candidate result awaiting confirmation
shared.awaitingConfirmHelp: Confirming records that this result was checked against the current input versions and lets the simulated run continue. The result stays visible afterwards.
shared.awaitingNoArtifact: This stage is waiting for confirmation, but no candidate result is available in this demo.
shared.needsReviewHelp: This result is marked as needing review and cannot be confirmed yet.
shared.artifactHistoryEmpty: No stage results have been produced yet.
shared.submitDisabledNoReport: The report stage has not produced a result yet.
shared.submitDisabledUnconfirmed: Confirm the report stage result before submitting the formal version.
shared.submitModalIntro: Check the frozen inputs and results that will be included in the formal version. Submission creates an immutable version.
shared.submitUnfinishedPlaceholder: Describe unchecked scope kept in a partial delivery.
shared.submitFail: Could not submit the formal version

workbench.scopeMissing: No scope note was recorded for this review.
workbench.reviewEndedText: The report has been delivered as a formal version. Findings and coverage stay readable and can still be used to start a revision task.
workbench.missingTarget: No reviewed object is recorded for this package.
workbench.missingTargetText: This demo package has no review target, so no document can be read and no conclusions are shown.
workbench.sourceUnavailableText: The exact reviewed version or material version is missing. Unavailable content is not shown as reviewed.
workbench.documentUnreadableText: The reviewed object exists, but this demo has no readable document body for it. Findings that point at it stay marked as requiring verification.
workbench.parseFailed: Parsing failed for the reviewed material
workbench.parseFailedText: The material could not be parsed, so nothing can be read here. It is not treated as reviewed.
workbench.pendingParse: The reviewed material is awaiting parse
workbench.pendingParseText: The material has not been parsed in this demo yet, so no content is presented as read.
workbench.partialParse: Only part of the reviewed material is readable
workbench.partialParseText: The parsed body is incomplete; the unreadable part stays outside the checked scope.
workbench.cannotReadTitle: The reviewed object cannot be read
workbench.basisUnreadableTitle: Some basis materials are not readable
workbench.basisUnreadableText: These inputs cannot be treated as verified basis: {{names}}

coverage.noLinkedFinding: No finding linked to this item
coverage.uncheckableHint: A cannot-check item always keeps its reason and is never counted as checked.
coverage.emptyText: The coverage stage has not produced a result in this demo. Nothing is marked as checked.

findings.emptyNoArtifactText: The inspection stage has not produced a result in this demo. This is not a zero-finding conclusion.
findings.emptyFilteredText: Clear or widen the filters to see all recorded findings.
findings.zeroTitle: No findings were found in this simulated review
findings.zeroText: This zero-finding conclusion only covers the checked scope below. It does not mean inspection never ran.
findings.zeroCoverage: Checked scope: {{checked}} of {{total}} items checked, {{uncheckable}} cannot be checked, {{notApplicable}} not applicable.
findings.zeroLimitations: Limitations recorded in the review report
findings.zeroNoReport: The report stage has not summarized the limitations yet.
findings.blockedMaterial: This review inspects a material, not a package version, so it cannot create a revision task from findings.
findings.blockedNoReport: Submit the review report first. A revision task must cite a formal review report version.
findings.blockedTargetUnavailable: The reviewed version is unavailable, so a revision task cannot cite it.
findings.footerHint: Only the selected findings are carried into the new revision task.

detail.emptyText: Choose a finding in the coverage & findings list to see its evidence, exact location and suggested action.
detail.emptyZero: This review recorded no findings within the checked scope.
detail.citationUnresolved: The citation could not be located in the reviewed document. Treat this finding as unverified.
detail.selectForRevision: Select this finding for a revision task
detail.basisUnreadable: The basis material is not readable. Only the recorded basis text is shown.
detail.notProfessional: Simulated finding — not a professional review conclusion.

basis.noRequirements: No extra requirements were recorded for this review task.
basis.noMaterials: No basis materials are linked to this review.
basis.unverified: Cannot be treated as verified basis
basis.demoNote: Basis materials are demo documents. Inputs that cannot be read are never counted as checked evidence.

report.notGeneratedTitle: The report stage has not produced a result yet
report.notGeneratedText: The report is assembled from confirmed coverage and findings in the report & delivery stage.
report.fullFallback: The full report body is available after the formal version is delivered in this demo. The summary below comes from the report stage result.
report.submitNewVersion: Created when the report is submitted

transfer.title: Create revision from selected findings
transfer.intro: The new task will cite the exact reviewed version and this review's formal report version. You will confirm the task title and authorized change scope in the generate wizard.
transfer.cancelNoRelation: Cancelling creates no package and no relation.

workbench.scopeMissing: No scope note was recorded for this comparison.
workbench.changeNotDefect: A change does not automatically mean a problem. Compliance still requires an independent review.
workbench.noInputsText: This comparison package has no input versions, so no two-sided document can be shown. Create a new comparison from the project.
workbench.baselineUnavailable: The baseline version is missing or unavailable.
workbench.targetUnavailable: The target version is missing or unavailable.
workbench.comparisonEndedText: The report has been delivered as a formal version. Differences and correspondence stay readable and can still be used to start a revision task.

differences.uncertainNote: Uncertain differences are never presented as facts; they need human verification.
differences.emptyNoArtifactText: The difference extraction stage has not produced a result in this demo. This does not mean the versions are identical.
differences.emptyFilteredText: Enable more change types to see all recorded differences.
differences.zeroTitle: No differences were found in the compared scope
differences.zeroText: This zero-difference result only covers the readable text shown below. Tables, attachments or other unreadable content are not covered.
differences.zeroLimitations: Limitations recorded in the comparison report
differences.blockedNoReport: Submit the comparison report first. A revision task must cite a formal comparison report version.
differences.footerHint: Unselected changes are not carried into the new revision task automatically.

docs.noActive: Select a difference to locate both sides.
docs.unreadableText: The version exists, but this demo has no readable document for it. Its content is not compared here.
docs.unavailableText: The referenced exact version is missing, so no content can be shown.

detail.emptyText: Choose a difference in the list to see both sides, the correspondence and the confidence.
detail.noSide: This change has no location on this side.
detail.noMapping: No correspondence was established for this change.
detail.uncertainConclusion: This change cannot be confirmed, so no definitive correspondence is concluded.
detail.notDefect: The comparison describes what changed. It does not judge whether the change is a defect.

mapping.emptyText: The mapping stage has not produced a result in this demo.
mapping.unconfirmedHint: Candidate and uncertain correspondences require human confirmation before they are cited as facts.

report.notGeneratedTitle: The report stage has not produced a result yet
report.notGeneratedText: The report summarizes differences, frozen inputs and limitations in the report & delivery stage.
report.fullFallback: The full report body is available after the formal version is delivered in this demo. The summary below comes from the report stage result.

transfer.title: Start revision from selected differences
transfer.intro: The new revision task cites this comparison's formal report version and only the selected differences. Unselected changes are not included automatically.
transfer.baseVersionHelp: Defaults to the target input of this comparison. You can choose another formal version in the project.
transfer.scopePlaceholder: State which sections or content this revision is authorized to change.
transfer.scopeRequired: The authorized change scope is required.
transfer.cancelNoRelation: Cancelling creates no package and no relation.
transfer.failed: Could not create the revision task
